summary: Juxtacrine signalling: a Delta/Jagged ligand on one cell triggers two proteolytic cleavages of Notch on the neighbouring cell, releasing the Notch intracellular domain (NICD) that acts directly as a transcriptional co-activator. (This file uses the compact 'steps/next' authoring format.)

references.label: Kopan & Ilagan (2009) Cell 137:216 — The canonical Notch signaling pathway

steps.name: Delta / Jagged (neighbouring cell)
steps.function: Membrane-bound ligand presented by an adjacent cell.

steps.name: NOTCH receptor
steps.function: Ligand endocytosis in the sending cell exerts a pulling force that exposes the S2 site.

steps.name: γ-Secretase (S3 cleavage)
steps.function: Intramembrane protease (presenilin) releases NICD. Target of γ-secretase inhibitors.

steps.name: CSL/RBPJ + Mastermind
steps.function: NICD displaces co-repressors from CSL and recruits MAML and co-activators.

steps.name: HES / HEY genes
steps.function: bHLH repressors that implement lateral inhibition.

steps.name: Cell-fate decision
steps.function: Lateral inhibition, stem-cell maintenance, T-cell development.
